focus: Explain scaled dot-product attention from Section 3.2.1 using small editable Q, K, and V matrices. Show similarity scores, normalized attention weights, and the weighted output. Let the learner switch scaling on and off, explore equal scores and a dominant score, and verify that every row of weights sums to one.
audience: A second-year engineering undergraduate who knows vectors, matrices, and basic probability but has not studied Transformers.
